title: The Clockmaker’s Secret
description: An interactive story where each decision leads to multiple paths, ultimately resulting in 16 unique endings.

start.text: Greywick is a strange town where time bends unnaturally. One evening, you find yourself standing before the long-abandoned Clockmaker’s Workshop. The door creaks open, revealing a faint golden glow inside. What do you do?

1A.ending: The Forgotten Future: You vanished into history.

1B.ending: The Lost Apprentice: Trapped in a loop of time, forever.

1C.ending: The Splintered Realities: You created chaos across time.

1D.ending: The Shifting Dream: Reality no longer stays the same.

2A.ending: The Clock’s Price: You were never meant to exist.

2B.ending: The Thief’s Punishment: Some knowledge isn’t meant to be stolen.

2C.ending: The Keyholder: The mystery remains unsolved… for now.

2D.ending: The Vanishing Town: You erased everything, including yourself.

3A.ending: The Archivist’s Curse: You must now record time, forever.

3B.ending: The Timewalker: You now exist between seconds.

3C.ending: The Endless Roles: You now live through infinite lifetimes.

3D.ending: The Inevitable: Some fates cannot be escaped.

4.text: Ignore the door and walk away.

4A.ending: The Town’s New Guardian: You will never leave.

4B.ending: The Multiplicity Trap: You are but one of many echoes.

4C.ending: The Edge of Reality: You fell beyond the known world.

4D.ending: The Last Still Point: You are now the only fixed moment in time.
